own_scenes.desc: El cruce del thrash con la música industrial de baile: Godflesh, Fear Factory o Rammstein. En la frontera están Ministry y Nine Inch Nails, que quizá sean más bien música industrial metalizada.

refs.q: Melding thrash with industrial dance music is the way bands as diverse as Godflesh, Fear Factory, and Rammstein create their sound.
refs.para: Melding thrash with industrial dance music is the way bands as diverse as Godflesh, Fear Factory, and Rammstein create their sound. On the border of this industrial metal subgenre are bands like Ministry and Nine Inch Nails, more accurately understood, perhaps, as metallized industrial music.
